title: Create a purchase quote to request an offer
summary: Create and manage purchase quotes to request offers from vendors, with the ability to convert accepted quotes into purchase orders. This page documents the process including quote creation, conversion to orders, and automatic vendor creation from contacts.
features: Create purchase quotes as preliminary drafts
Convert purchase quotes to purchase orders
Create quotes for contacts without existing vendor records
Automatic vendor creation from contact data
Vendor template selection based on territory and country/region
